newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty closes flat vs basket, one-day depos lower.
newsitem.headline: Zloty closes flat vs basket, one-day depos lower.

text.p: 1230 GMT - The Polish zloty closed flat at 3.02/2.98 pct from the parity rate against Wednesday's 3.01/2.98 pct after late foreign currency sell orders neutralised an early zloty slip against the basket, dealers said.
* It closed at 3.0690/00 to the dollar, down from 3.0673/85 on Wednesday and at 1.8365/73 to the mark, down from 1.8350/55.
* O/N at 22.30/22.60 pct vs opening's 22.45/22.65 pct.
* T/N at 22.35/22.70 pct vs opening's 22.45/22.70 pct.
* The central bank kept the average yield of its 182-day and 273-day NBP-bills flat at 22.00 pct, selling 400 million zlotys of both terms on Thursday.
